Overlay

Introduction

Create a mask layer to emphasize specific page elements and prevent users from performing other operations.

Sample Code

1. Basic Usage

<maui-button type="primary" bind:click="onClickShow">show mask layer </maui-button>
<maui-overlay show="{{ show }}" bind:click="onClickHide" />
Page({ data: { show: false, }, onClickShow() { this.setData({ show: true }); }, onClickHide() { this.setData({ show:
false }); },});

2. Embedded Content

Any content can be embedded at the mask layer through the default slot.

<maui-button type="primary" bind:click="onClickShow">embedded content </maui-button>
<maui-overlay show="{{ show }}" bind:click="onClickHide">
  <view class="wrapper">
    <view class="block" catch:tap="noop" />
  </view>
</maui-overlay>
Page({ data: { show: false, }, onClickShow() { this.setData({ show: true }); }, onClickHide() { this.setData({ show:
false }); }, noop() {}, }); .wrapper { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100%; }
.block { width: 120px; height: 120px; background-color: #fff; }

Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
show Whether to display the mask layer. Boolean false
z-index z-index level. String | Number 1
duration Animation duration, in milliseconds. String | Number 300
custom-style Custom style. String -

Events

Event Description Callback Parameter
bind:click Triggered at a click. -

Slots

Name Description
- Default slot for embedding content at the mask layer.
